scenarios.title: 1. Verify evaluation panel initial texts and button label before patch
scenarios.purpose: Ensure the evaluation panel shows the old heading and button label before the patch which changes the button text from 'Generate Playwright plan' to 'Generate test plan'.

scenarios.title: 2. Check evaluation status text and saved results before patch
scenarios.purpose: Confirm the evaluation status reads 'Results saved' when evaluation is available, matching pre-change behavior.

scenarios.title: 4. Ensure 'Analyze change' button is disabled when API not ready and inputs empty
scenarios.purpose: Validate that the analyze change button is disabled as expected before patch when API is not ready or no inputs are provided.
